extraction_notes: Main-text measured catalytic-performance figures digitised: Figures 1 and 2. Characterisation figures, DFT schematics, DRIFTS/TPD/XPS/XRD/TEM, and literature-comparison table were not treated as plotted catalytic performance. Feed H2/CO2 composition was not given in the provided main text; conditions such as pressure/GHSV were taken from Section 3.1, figure captions, and the CoIn-BP-1 condition in Table 1 where needed. All plotted values are approximate readings from markers/bar tops and use qualifier '~'.
